test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the dice that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22e729479f819a719e03b4d2f665097e4d6c504f3a72f2a6b6c07ab7d53a3f7c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/399e2e8a2a832250f317033bda87e79e3178c60437184daad036764b3e2695e4.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fa85ad80497367fd0ea9e112b0a21940aa41fb0e899ed34e47b8d898f545256.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• 1 → 2
 
• 3 → 4
 
• 6 → 5

Therefore,

(A) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93a5958115e592b9f64b56c2e7b666602dfe38effa51ea5a5d3e262a0f6dd224.png] ⇒ Correct (As 1 is opposite to 2, 3 is opposite to 4 and 5 is opposite to 6. So one number of each pair is shown)

(B) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35d3acf2715bcc1197752592a95205bf524c929b82cadcafa21504ea84267fdc.png] ⇒Correct (As 2 is opposite to 1, 4 is opposite to 3 and 6 is opposite to 5. So one number of each pair is shown)

(C) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eed1283cfda1fed5da9867967ab21ec3188e95a76945a294efc5d1b224cd63c7.png] ⇒Incorrect (As 4 is opposite to 3, 3 is opposite to 4 and 5 is opposite to 6. So one full pair cannot be shown)

(D) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e7c9d57685d542ded6d964635967eb68f215691f411cbfc7eb575cea8de9642.png] ⇒Incorrect (As 1 is opposite to 2, 2 is opposite to 1 and 3 is opposite to 4. So one full pair cannot be shown)

Hence, **"Only A and B"** is the correct answer.
